hypothesis: For the exact retained seed-3788 synthetic role-skill JSON, per-request read/parse/full validation/selected-role construction has greater lifetime cost than one full validation/all-role construction followed by reuse across the first 40 requests, with identical predictions.
treatment: Five paired alternating AB/BA blocks, each arm processes the same fixed 40-request A/B/C schedule. RELOAD_EACH_REQUEST includes complete load, digest/schema/shape validation and selected-role construction for every request. LOAD_ONCE_REUSE includes one complete load and construction of all roles in its initialization cost.
decision: PASS_LIFECYCLE_FIRST_RUNG_SCOPED only when container construction matches all 12,288 retained predictions, all 400 timed predictions match both arms and retained pred, independent raw-only audit has zero errors and rejects all seven mutations, reuse wins all five paired blocks, median lifetime-cost ratio <=0.90, and source/reference/input/image identities remain exact. Otherwise preserve exact FAIL/HOLD/STOP; no retry or replacement allocation.
control: Same package, rows, corrected scorer, fixed schedule, CPU-only runtime and image; only lifecycle differs. Startup excluded equally, reuse includes initialization, reload includes per-request validation/construction; AB/BA order alternates.
uncertainty: One synthetic package/seed, five pairs, N=40 per arm per block, cached linux/amd64 emulated Python image. No PyTorch/framework speed, broad workload, task-success, GUI, authority, production, or product claim. A scoped pilot PASS only supports a separately frozen larger run and does not close #4916.
